name: OpenAICompatible
description: An LLM provider for any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (vLLM, LM Studio, llama.cpp server, a company gateway). It registers with the LLM object on startup, so its models appear in Settings → AI tier routing beside the built-in providers.

interface.name: OpenAICompatible
interface.description: LLM provider backed by an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Register with the LLM object using this package's settings. Returns { registered, reason?, backends? }.

methods.name: providerComplete
methods.description: Called by the LLM object: run one chat completion on the configured endpoint. Returns { content, finishReason, usage? }.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Call options; options.model is the model to run

methods.name: changed
methods.description: Receives change notifications from the Packages service and re-registers when this package's settings change.
